newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Air Support is Benelux gsa for new Georgian airline.
newsitem.headline: Air Support is Benelux gsa for new Georgian airline.

text.p: Air Support has been appointed the Benelux general sales agent for Georgian Airlines, the new national flag carrier of Georgia.
Georgian Airlines, which is wholly-owned by the Georgian government, has just acquired Orbi Georgian Airways and it has now become the national carrier, Carlo de Haas, Air Support spokesman said.
The new airline will operate a weekly Tupolev 154 flight on Fridays from Amsterdam to Tbilisi, the capital of Georgia, offering four tonnes of cargo capacity.
But the Tupolev is expected to be replaced by a Boeing 737-300 in November, he said.
Orbi Georgian Airlines had been a customer of Air Support since early 1996.

At Amsterdam's Schiphol airport, Georgian Airlines will be handled by Ogden Aviation and at Brussels Airport the handler will be Eurohandling. Cargo will be trucked over night to Amsterdam by Rutges. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
